app.name: ELSA Speak - English Learning
app.description: AI-powered English pronunciation coach that uses speech recognition to help users improve their English speaking skills.

verdict.one_liner: AI English tutor with solid learning features, but shares your voice data and personal info with advertisers.
verdict.summary: ELSA Speak is an AI-powered English pronunciation app that records your voice to provide feedback. While it offers genuine educational value, the privacy policy reveals extensive data sharing with advertising networks, marketing services, and social networks. Your voice recordings and personal data may be used for targeted advertising, and the app admits to 'selling' data under US privacy laws.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app's core function requires recording your voice, which is necessary for pronunciation training. However, the extensive data sharing with advertisers and marketing networks goes beyond what's needed for the educational service. Users concerned about their voice data being used for profiling should consider this carefully.

red.title: Voice data shared with advertisers
red.plain_english: ELSA records your voice to check your pronunciation, but they also share your personal information with advertising networks and marketing companies. This means data about how you use the app could be used to show you ads elsewhere.

red.title: Admits to 'selling' your data
red.plain_english: The privacy policy explicitly states they have 'sold' or 'shared' personal information under California privacy laws for targeted advertising. You have to email them to opt out.

red.title: Shares data with many third parties
red.plain_english: They share your data with a long list of companies including marketing services, social networks, content enrichment providers, and advertising networks—not just essential service providers.

red.title: Data stored worldwide
red.plain_english: Your personal data is stored and processed in multiple countries including the US, Europe, Japan, India, Vietnam, and Singapore. This means your data is subject to different privacy laws depending on where it's stored.

red.title: No real age verification
red.plain_english: They say their service is for ages 16+ and will delete data if they find out a minor is using it, but there's no actual age check when you sign up. They only rely on you telling the truth.

green.title: Provides data rights (GDPR/CCPA)
green.plain_english: You can request to see, correct, delete, or export your personal data. They have a dedicated privacy email and a Data Protection Officer to handle these requests.

green.title: Clear data retention policy
green.plain_english: They explain how long they keep your data and allow you to request deletion. They won't keep your data longer than necessary for their services and legal obligations.

green.title: Voice processing for core feature
green.plain_english: Recording your voice is necessary for the app's main purpose—helping you improve your English pronunciation. This isn't data collection just for the sake of it.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: ELSA needs to record your voice to check your pronunciation—this is the app's main feature. They store these recordings and may share them with service providers.
categories.detail: Voice recordings are essential for the app's pronunciation coaching feature. The policy states they collect 'audio and video recordings' as user-generated content. While this is necessary for the core functionality, the data is stored and may be shared with third parties.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect the following data about Organic Users: User-generated content: prompts, text input, pictures, audio and video recordings, feedback, scenarios.
concerns: Audio data may be shared with service providers

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: ELSA doesn't appear to collect your precise GPS location. They may see your general region from your IP address for basic service delivery.
categories.detail: No mention of GPS or precise location collection in the privacy policy. IP addresses are collected for connectivity purposes, which may reveal approximate location.
categories.policy_excerpt: IP addresses, device data (like type, OS, device id, browser version, locale and language settings used)

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: There's no indication that ELSA accesses your phone's contact list or address book.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention any collection of contacts or phonebook data.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The app may access your photos or files when you choose to upload them, like for a profile picture. This is optional and only happens when you specifically select something.
categories.detail: The policy mentions collecting 'pictures' as user-generated content, suggesting users can upload images. This appears to be optional functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: User-generated content: prompts, text input, pictures, audio and video recordings
concerns: Photo uploads mentioned but context unclear

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: ELSA shares your data with many third parties including advertising networks, marketing services, social networks, and content enrichment providers. They explicitly state they've 'sold' data under California privacy laws for targeted advertising.
categories.detail: Extensive data sharing is disclosed, including with marketing services, social and advertising networks, and content enrichment providers. The policy explicitly acknowledges 'selling' data under CCPA for targeted advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: We engage selected third-party companies and individuals... including... marketing services, social and advertising networks, content and data enrichment providers... In the last 12 months, we have 'sold' or 'shared' Internet or other electronic network activity information, Geolocation Data, and Commercial Information... for targeted advertising.
concerns: Many third-party recipients including ad networks

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You need an account to use ELSA. They collect your name, email, and profile information. This data is linked to your learning progress and may be shared with service providers.
categories.detail: Account creation requires providing personal information including name, email, and possibly age range and professional information. This is standard for educational apps.
categories.policy_excerpt: Contact and business details: name, email, phone number, age range, position, workplace and professional information
concerns: Identity data shared with marketing partners

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: ELSA uses cookies, device identifiers, and other tracking technologies to analyze your behavior and show you targeted ads. They share this tracking data with advertising partners.
categories.detail: The app uses cookies, pixels, SDKs, and device identifiers for marketing, analytics, and targeted advertising. They explicitly state this data is 'sold' or 'shared' under US privacy laws for targeted advertising purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We and our service providers utilize third-party software development kits (SDKs), cookies, pixels and similar technologies... to analyse our performance and marketing activities... In the last 12 months, we have 'sold' or 'shared'... for targeted advertising.
concerns: Device identifiers used for ad targeting

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: ELSA says their app isn't for kids under 16, but they don't actually check your age when you sign up. They just trust that users tell the truth.
categories.detail: The policy states the service is not designed for minors and requires users to be 16+. However, there's no actual age verification mechanism—reliance is solely on user self-declaration.
categories.policy_excerpt: Any individual who provides their personal data to us through the Services represents that they are 16 years of age or older. If we learn that a person who is considered as a minor according to applicable law is interacting with our Services... we will attempt to prohibit and block such use.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: ELSA logs your IP address and activity on the app to deliver the service and for security. This is fairly standard, but this data may also be used for marketing purposes.
categories.detail: IP addresses and activity logs are collected for service delivery and security. However, this network data is also shared for marketing and advertising purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: Connectivity, technical and aggregated usage data: IP addresses, device data... activity logs, session recordings, inferred or presumed data generated from the Services
concerns: Activity logs shared with third parties

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: ELSA collects your device ID, browser type, and other technical details. They use this to track you across sessions and share it with advertising partners.
categories.detail: Device identifiers and technical data are collected and used for marketing, advertising, and service improvement. This includes device unique identifiers which can be used for fingerprinting and tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: IP addresses, device data (like type, OS, device id, browser version, locale and language settings used)... We and our service providers utilize third-party software development kits (SDKs), cookies, pixels and similar technologies

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Your voice is technically a biometric. ELSA records and analyzes your voice to check pronunciation. While this is necessary for the app, your voice data is stored on their servers and may be shared.
categories.detail: Voice recordings are collected and analyzed for pronunciation coaching. While processed for the core feature, voice data is considered biometric information and is stored and potentially shared with third parties.
categories.policy_excerpt: User-generated content: prompts, text input, pictures, audio and video recordings, feedback, scenarios
concerns: May be shared with service providers
No clear retention period for voice data

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: When you pay for ELSA Premium, your payment is processed by Apple. ELSA doesn't directly handle your credit card information.
categories.detail: Payment processing is handled through Apple's in-app purchase system. The app only shares limited purchase activity data with Apple for refund processing, not raw financial data.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we receive a refund request for an in-app purchase, we may provide Apple with information about the user's in-app purchase activity... This could include details such as time since app installation, total app usage time, an anonymous account identifier
concerns: Limited purchase activity shared with Apple for refunds

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You have the right to request your data be deleted or exported. They have a dedicated privacy email and comply with GDPR and CCPA rights.
categories.detail: Clear data subject rights are provided including access, correction, deletion, and portability. A dedicated privacy contact (privacy@elsanow.io) and Data Protection Officer are designated.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may also have the right to restrict or object to the processing of your personal data, the right to direct us not to sell or share your personal data... please contact us by e-mail at: privacy@elsanow.io

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: ELSA can change their privacy policy and will post the updated version. They say they'll give notice for 'substantial changes' but continuing to use the app means you accept the changes.
categories.detail: Policy updates are posted with an effective date. They claim to provide prior notice for substantial changes, but continued use constitutes acceptance of amendments.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may update and amend this Privacy Notice from time to time by posting an amended version... We will provide prior notice if we believe any substantial changes are involved... After such notice period, all amendments shall be deemed accepted by you.
concerns: Opt-out by停止使用 rather than active consent for changes
